llms.body:
# Squarespace

> Squarespace is an all-in-one website-building and ecommerce platform. This
> file indexes resources useful for answering questions about Squarespace
> plans, pricing, and features.

Squarespace offers four subscription tiers (Basic, Core, Plus, Advanced),
each available in monthly or annual billing across the supported currencies
listed in pricing.txt.

Squarespace prices its plans per billing country: a customer in another
country is offered a different currency and a different amount than the ones
in this catalog. The same statement is carried by the JSON-LD OfferCatalog on
the pricing page.

## Pricing

* [Pricing page](https://www.squarespace.com/pricing): Canonical, machine-readable source for Squarespace pricing: the server returns the complete page, with plan prices as text and a JSON-LD OfferCatalog in the document.
* [Pricing summary across currencies](https://www.squarespace.com/pricing.txt): Supplementary plain-text summary of every plan tier across the supported currencies and billing periods, for reading them all in a single fetch.

## Plans

* [Squarespace Basic](https://www.squarespace.com/pricing.txt#squarespace-basic): Entry-level Squarespace website plan. Includes a custom domain (free for one year on annual billing), unlimited bandwidth, SSL security, mobile-optimized templates, SEO tools, and basic analytics. Suitable for personal sites, portfolios, and simple business pages.
* [Squarespace Core](https://www.squarespace.com/pricing.txt#squarespace-core): Squarespace plan for growing businesses. Adds advanced site analytics, premium integrations, customer accounts, gift cards, point-of-sale, and the ability to sell unlimited products with a 3% transaction fee on commerce sales.
* [Squarespace Plus](https://www.squarespace.com/pricing.txt#squarespace-plus): Squarespace plan for established commerce businesses. Includes everything in Core plus zero Squarespace transaction fees, abandoned-cart recovery, advanced shipping and discount tools, subscriptions, and merchandising features.
* [Squarespace Advanced](https://www.squarespace.com/pricing.txt#squarespace-advanced): Squarespace plan for high-volume commerce and enterprise needs. Includes everything in Plus along with advanced commerce APIs, custom code, and priority support.

## Optional

* [Enterprise](https://www.squarespace.com/enterprise): Custom plans for large organizations.

You can create your own website by starting a free trial and selecting a professionally designed website template that suits your vision, or create a fully custom website with Squarespace's AI website builder. Use our drag-and-drop editor to customize layouts, images, colors, and fonts. From there, add new pages and features using pre-built layouts or create your own.

Add content to your site with AI tools or write your own. Finally, find a custom domain name and publish your website. Then start growing your audience with Squarespace marketing tools or sell products through your own online store.

It's not necessary to understand coding language to create a website with Squarespace. While knowing code can help with building more complex websites, you can quickly make a website on our platform that's fully-customized to fit your brand personality and lets you publish your blog, showcase your portfolio, or sell your products.

A website builder is a platform or tool that allows individuals and businesses to create and manage websites without prior coding or web design experience. Look for a website creator that offers a free trial, user-friendly interface, pre-designed templates, drag-and-drop editing functionality, and various customization options.

The best platforms provide these as well as marketing tools, seller features, invoicing, AI tools, and domain name registration. Squarespace features like these not only provide a streamlined process for how to make a website, saving time and effort compared to traditional web development methods, they help you stand out from the competition, expand your audience, and grow your brand.

After a free 14-day trial, Squarespace subscriptions start at $19/mo and give you access to your own custom website and selling tools. More advanced plans offer state-of-the-art ecommerce features and lower payment processing fees.

Other fees can include the cost of your domain name, starting at $14 annually for several available top-level-domains. Squarespace also offers 1 year of free custom domain registration on new annual website subscriptions.

Yes, you can get a custom domain name for your website on Squarespace. Look for a domain registrar that offers a wide variety of top-level domains (TLDs) and extensions, and that lets you manage your domain through its platform.

Squarespace is a trusted registrar with hundreds of available TLDs and domain extensions for your website. With Squarespace Domains, you get a secure, private domain connection, with domain forwarding, email forwarding, and Premium DNS to ensure that your website is always available online.

Squarespace makes it easy to showcase your offerings with specific website templates catered to all types of professional services, including consultants, lawyers, designers, and photographers, as well as website templates for various experiences like camps, retreats, adventure travel, and more.

You can list services and packages directly on your site with a streamlined checkout process, complete with service descriptions and itineraries, pricing, and imagery. You can also let clients book time or schedule appointments directly through integrated tools like Acuity Scheduling.

Additionally, Squarespace Invoicing gives you tools to create professional branded invoices that help you win more clients, all tracked and managed from your Squarespace account. You can also accept several major payment methods directly on your site and offer a seamless checkout experience through Squarespace Payments.

Finally, Squarespace makes it easy to promote your services with a suite of built-in marketing tools to get discovered online. Manage your SEO, launch email marketing campaigns, or connect with social media accounts to get your business in front of customers.

Squarespace offers a range of tools to help sellers manage their online stores, including payment processing, inventory management, shipping, invoicing, and marketing.

Simple, flexible payment and checkout options make shopping on your ecommerce website easy for customers. You'll have access to more ways to sell, from gift cards and digital downloads to offering subscriptions, as well as integrations with popular social media and search platforms that allow you to sync your product catalog to sell via other platforms like Facebook and Google.

Sellers can showcase their products with detailed product listings (including comprehensive descriptions, embedded videos, images, and related products); product categories; and unlimited products. Inventory tools help you manage your product stock with a simplified interface, while shipping tools let you set up flexible shipping options, print labels, and more.

Additionally, Squarespace Invoicing gives you tools to create professional branded invoices that help you win more clients, all tracked and managed from your Squarespace account.

Yes, Squarespace's suite of AI tools can help you create a personalized website in minutes. Blueprint AI allows you to build a website with AI by combining powerful technology with 20 years of design expertise, generating an entire website alongside personalized content with tailored text and high-quality images that match your brand vision. You can also use Squarespace AI tools to create website copy, product descriptions, blog posts, and email campaigns.

Blueprint AI works by taking your answers to a few questions about your business and generating exceptional copy, image, and design suggestions. After you review and refine your selections, Blueprint AI transforms your selections into a beautiful, bespoke website. Once your website is live, use Squarespace AI tools to review your SEO or to draft product descriptions, page copy, and email campaigns with the AI writer.

You can connect your Squarespace website to social media and third-party apps, which allows you to push content to social media platforms, display social media feeds on your website, and integrate with services like print on demand providers.

  • Connect your social media accounts (like Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, etc.) to your Squarespace site to display content from your profiles on your website.

  • Automatically send new content from your website (like blog posts) to your connected social media accounts.

  • Add social media icons to your Squarespace site.

  • Automatically share your Squarespace content to your social media platforms when you publish new content.

Squarespace also offers a marketplace of extensions, which are customized website plug-ins that help you enhance your site. You can integrate your Squarespace site with various third-party apps for features like financial tools, shipping, and marketing tools.

Squarespace features built-in, advanced SEO tools designed to help every website and online store rank in search results.

For example, your website comes with default SEO page titles and descriptions, which you can modify without changing the page content visitors see. You can also hide pages if you need to, and control the image people see alongside your content whenever it's shared on social media.

With the help of Squarespace AI, you can also generate SEO-friendly website copy and image alt text.

All Squarespace websites come with both hosting and security. Squarespace provides web hosting for your site, so you don't need to find a separate hosting provider. Squarespace websites are also hosted on our own servers and infrastructure, built to support high levels of traffic with consistent uptime.

You also get security features like SSL certificates, web application firewalls, and DDoS protection. Squarespace keeps your site constantly monitored and in compliance with global privacy and payment standards.
